replay_notes.price: close of the evaluated bar (live: Bybit last price at request time)
replay_notes.klines: Binance USDT-M closed 1h/4h/1D candles that closed at or before the bar close (live: Bybit-first closed candles)
replay_notes.funding: last SETTLED Binance funding rate at or before the bar close (live: Bybit predicted rate); trend from the last 8 settlements
replay_notes.fear_greed: alternative.me daily value whose day started at or before the bar close
replay_notes.session/killzone/vwap: computed for the bar close time
replay_notes.left out (neutral in the scoring code): Bybit OI change, Hyperliquid book ratio, taker long/short ratio, liquidations, Deribit options, BTC correlation — no public history that covers the whole window

rule: +1 ATR14 in the lean's direction before -1 ATR against within 12 bars (analyst_store.evaluate_outcome); ambiguous = both in one bar
